sections.label: Mind
sections.text:
Irritable and depressed. Forgetful, lack of
concentration.

sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Dull, aching; better cold, pressure. Dull
frontal and supra-orbital headache; worse moving eyes,
cold air; better, warmth.

sections.label: Face
sections.text: Skin feels dry and itches. Acne on chin.

sections.label: Throat
sections.text:
Irritated; pain to ears; sore, dry, with
hawking and expertoratiou.

Elyes. — Burn, red ; worse, any change of temperature.

sections.label: Nose
sections.text:
Bland coryza; stuffed feeling; feels sore in-
side. Irresistible desire to sneeze.


393

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Disagreeable taste, burning sensation,
very thirsty. Nausea. Increased appetite. ,

sections.label: Abdomen
sections.text:
Disposition to soft, shapeless stools.
Griping in umbilical and left hypogastric region. Early
morning diarrhoea.

sections.label: Urine
sections.text:
Increased in quantity and frequency. Burn-
ing pain in meatus. Uric acid deposits.

sections.label: Female
sections.text:
Fullness in lower abdomen. Nausea at
time of menses.

sections.label: Respiratory
sections.text:
Coryza ; dry, teasing cough. Bron-
chiectasis and phthisis. Bronchitis, especially of the
aged.

sections.label: Skin
sections.text:
Heat and irritation ; itching. Scaly and itch-
ing eczema. Crops of boils. Pruritus of pregnancy.

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Lameness in right shoulder and right
lower extremity.

sections.label: Relationship
sections.text:
Compare: Hepar; Calc.; Silica;
Sttlph.-: Ars.; Petrol.
